name: Research Cat — citation network explorer
kind: dynamic Cordis plugin for DeepSeek Harness (runtime-only; not an installable npm package)

load.steps: cordis_define (kind=new, code.host from host.js, code.client from client.js) then cordis_run (mode=run) and approve the client half in the Run card

data_source: OpenAlex REST API (https://api.openalex.org) - public, no API key required

layout.algorithm: hub-centred radial: pick the highest-degree node as the hub, BFS layers from it, one radius band per layer, split each layer into contiguous angular sectors by relationship role (references / citations / related), order each sector by citedBy desc, fill rings using capacity = floor(arc * r / minSpacing) with a half-slot stagger between adjacent rings, then separate hub spokes to a minimum angle

measured.single_seed_55_nodes: total edge length 15659 -> 10124, longest edge 370 -> 248 px, hub min angular gap 0.4deg -> 2.9deg
measured.dual_seed_101_nodes: total edge length 28456 -> 11516, edge crossings 6 -> 0, hub min angular gap 0.0deg -> 2.9deg

visual_semantics.node_size_and_brightness: normalised by citation count (sqrt of share of the graph maximum)
visual_semantics.node_stroke: relationship to the collection: references (brand) / citations (warn) / related (tertiary)
visual_semantics.labels: always on for the seeds and the top 18 papers by citations, all labels at zoom >= 1.8
visual_semantics.selection: selecting a node highlights its incident edges and dims unrelated nodes and edges

persistence: none. All state lives in five in-memory containers (nodes, links, catalog, seeds, cache) inside the apply() closure; neither half calls fs, a storage service or localStorage, and the harness web service defines no disk cache. Note: retrieval driven through the agent Tool does land in the harness session transcript, while panel-only use does not pass through the model.
runtime: dynamic Cordis plugins live only in the current DSH process; a DSH restart removes the plugin and it must be loaded again
